subject: general
question: Ranji Trophy is related to which of the following game?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Cricket.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Ranji Trophy** is a **domestic first-class cricket** championship played in India.
 
• It was named after **Ranjitsinhji, **the first Indian cricketer to play** Test cricket.**
 
• The tournament was first played in** 1934 **and has been a major platform for young cricketers to showcase their talent and get selected for the national team.
 
• The current champions of Ranji Trophy are** Saurashtra**, who won the tournament in the **2019-20 season.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Tennis:** **Davis Cup** is a premier international team event for **men's tennis**, while** Fed Cup** is the equivalent for women's** tennis.**
 
• **Baseball: Major League Baseball (MLB)** is the professional baseball league in the **United States and Canada.**
 
• **Football: FIFA World Cup** is the biggest international football tournament held every four years, while** UEFA Champions League **is the premier club competition in European football.
